narration.hook: What if a microscope knew when to look?
narration.reveal: Meet Peekaboo. Software that chooses when a microscope takes its next image.

reveal.text: A soft airy cinematic reveal, warm and minimal, no voice, no music, no loud impact.

capture.text: One gentle optical shutter tick, precise and delicate, no harsh click, no voice or music.

transition.text: A subtle short airy whoosh for a calm scientific product film, no impact or music.
